description:
Implement the runtime pieces needed for bundled desktop apps to participate in the same discovery model on every supported platform.

This should cover:
- Windows parity for the current bundle-local Vrooli discovery shim behavior
- consistent handling of `vrooli scenario port` style lookups inside downloaded apps
- runtime precedence so downloaded apps override same-scenario local swarm instances by default
- documentation and tests for the bundle-local discovery contract
- preserving room for a future explicit override layer without blocking the default behavior now

Goal: bundled apps resolve the right peer services consistently across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
name: cross-platform-bundled-discovery-parity
title: Implement Cross Platform Bundled Discovery Parity
